name: Moonlight
description: Moonlight is an open-source game-streaming client for Sunshine hosts. It supports hardware video decoding, gamepads, and keyboard and mouse input.

notes.text: Wait for moonlight-setup.service, then reboot the guest. Sign in with your Cloud-Init user; desktop autologin is optional.
Connect the display to the selected GPU. Its output is unavailable in noVNC; selected USB ports are dedicated to this VM.
Add the Sunshine host in Moonlight and enter the PIN displayed by Moonlight on Sunshine's PIN page.
